use_weighted_loss_decorator: use the weighted_loss decorator to add weight and reduction arguments to a custom element-wise loss function
call_reduce_loss: call reduce_loss to apply mean or sum reduction to an element-wise PyTorch loss tensor
call_weight_reduce_loss: call weight_reduce_loss to apply element-wise weights and reduction to a loss tensor with optional avg_factor
create_custom_weighted_l1_loss: create a custom L1 loss function decorated with weighted_loss to support per-element weighting and reduction
refactor_loss_function_for_weighting: refactor an existing element-wise loss function to support weighting and reduction using the weighted_loss decorator
